home.introBody: In this craft since 2004. My driving force has always been a deep love of creativity and art, and the desire to master the endless possibilities this field offers. Years of tireless work and hands-on experience have shaped me into a truly universal professional — equally at home sketching a concept, drafting a pattern, or fitting the final seam.
